name: Hamsuke
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Character)Hamsuke, the Wise King of the Forest, is a gigantic hamster-like creature with a long prehensile snake-like tail. She is very strong, with steel-durable fur and a tail that can rip off a knight's head. She can also cast basic low-tier magic via body sigils.
